title: Bag of Bricks - Coffee 14
descriptionHtml:
Coffee — colour 14

A deep roasted brown that does shadow work without the harshness of black. Ideal for dark hair, and for the darkest areas of a warm-toned image where black would look like a hole.

Works well with: Dark Brown 30, Toffee 29, Caramel 15

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Coffee bricks (colour 14) for Memobrick mosaics. A deep roasted brown for shadow work, dark hair and rich contrast against lighter tones.
